items.raw_excerpt: Long queues formed at Keflavík International Airport this morning, with lines extending outside the terminal for the second time in recent days. items.raw_excerpt: Mr Tan Chun Lim, 81, owns and runs the last "pure stamp shop" in Singapore. With 70 years of stamp collecting and dealing under his belt, he shares with CNA TODAY his fondest memories of what used to be a wildly popular hobby – and what's next for his dwindling trade.
